         1                 P R O C E E D I N G S

         2                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

         3       The Senate will please come to order.

         4                  I ask everyone present to rise and

         5       recite with me the Pledge of Allegiance to our

         6       Flag.

         7                  (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

         8       the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        10       In the absence of clergy, may we all bow our

        11       heads for a moment of silence.

        12                  (Whereupon, the assemblage

        13       respected a moment of silence.)

        14                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        15       Thank you.

        16                  Senator Klein.

        17                  SENATOR KLEIN:    Madam President,

        18       is there a proclamation from the Governor at

        19       the desk?

        20                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        21       Yes, Senator Klein, there is a proclamation

        22       here at the desk.

        23                  The Secretary will read.

        24                  THE SECRETARY:    "Pursuant to the



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         5705



         1       power vested in me by Article IV, Section 3 of

         2       the Constitution, I hereby convene the Senate

         3       of the State of New York in Extraordinary

         4       Session, at the Capitol, in the City of

         5       Albany, on the seventh day of July, two

         6       thousand nine, at three o'clock p.m., for the

         7       purpose of considering legislation I will

         8       submit with respect to various subjects, and

         9       acting on gubernatorial nominations.

        10                  "Given under my hand and the Privy

        11       Seal of the State in the City of Albany this

        12       sixth day of July in the year two thousand

        13       nine, by the Governor, David A. Paterson."

        14                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        15       The proclamation having been read, the Senate

        16       is in extraordinary session.

        17                  Senator Klein.

        18                  SENATOR KLEIN:    Madam President,

        19       will you please recognize Senator Skelos.

        20                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        21       Senator Skelos.

        22                  SENATOR SKELOS:    Thank you.  And

        23       good afternoon, Senator Stewart-Cousins.

        24                  First, I'd like to announce that



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         5706



         1       there will be a conference of the coalition

         2       following this extraordinary session.

         3                  And I'd like to of course mention

         4       that this session has been called by the

         5       Governor.  And certainly the courts have

         6       ordered that we convene, and I underline the

         7       word "convene," in this extraordinary session.

         8                  Pursuant to the vote which took

         9       place on June 8th, the designation of a

        10       presiding officer should be made by Senator

        11       Espada or myself.  Accordingly, we do not

        12       recognize that you are the appropriately

        13       designated presiding officer.  Or, quite

        14       frankly, if there is an attempt to call a

        15       regular session, certainly that authority does

        16       not exist with any other member but Senator

        17       Espada or myself, pursuant to the vote on

        18       June 8th.

        19                  Therefore, I'd request that the

        20       agenda be laid aside and move that the Senate

        21       adjourn this special session sine die.

        22                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        23       Thank you, Senator.

        24                  Senator Klein.



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1                  SENATOR KLEIN:    Madam President,

         2       I move that we do not take up any legislative

         3       activity at this time and that we adjourn

         4       sine die.

         5                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

         6       On motion of Senator Klein, we will adjourn

         7       sine die.

         8                  (Whereupon, at 3:10 p.m., the

         9       Senate adjourned.)
